title: My cart
emptyHint: Pick a room on a listing page and use "Add to cart" to book several rooms or properties with a single payment.
totalNotice: Taxes included. All rooms are held together and confirmed with one payment; if one is unavailable, none are booked.
lockedNotice: The cart is held for payment. Release the hold to make changes.

item.childrenRange: Children must be a whole number from {min} to {max}. The saved value ({saved}) was restored.

add.hint: Book several rooms or properties with one payment.
add.loginHint: You'll be asked to sign in to add to your cart; your selections are kept.

checkout.title: Group booking
checkout.holdHint: All rooms are held together before payment (all or nothing).
checkout.heldUntil: All rooms are held for you until {time}.
checkout.priceChanged: The price changed. Review the new total and try again.
checkout.itemUnavailable: One of the rooms is no longer available; no rooms were held.
checkout.declined: Payment declined; all holds were released. You can hold again and try another card.
checkout.expired: The hold expired and the rooms were released. You can restore the cart and hold the rooms again.
checkout.confirmPending: Your payment was received; the booking confirmation is being completed.

checkout.rehold: Press "Hold rooms" to hold the rooms again.
checkout.expiredNoCart: The cart closed because the hold expired. You can restore the cart and hold the rooms again.
checkout.reopened: The cart was restored. Hold the rooms to continue to payment.
checkout.pendingWait: The booking confirmation will complete within a few seconds. This page updates by itself; do not pay again.
checkout.pendingSlow: Confirmation is taking longer than expected. Your payment was received; do not pay again. Your bookings will appear in My trips once confirmed and we will email you.

split.title: Split the payment with your group
split.intro: Each participant pays their own share with their own card. Once every share is in, all rooms are confirmed together.
split.remainderHint: Leftover cents are added to your share.
split.fallbackOrganizer: Unpaid shares fall to you at the deadline (you pay the rest).
split.fallbackRefund: If shares are missing at the deadline, every payment is refunded and the rooms are released.

planStatus.FALLBACK: Remaining amount is on the organizer

share.confirmed: Every share is paid — the booking is confirmed!
share.closed: This split payment is no longer open.

cancelConfirmBody: All rooms in the cart will be removed and the cart will be closed. This can't be undone.
cancelConfirmHeld: The rooms are currently held for you. If you empty the cart, the hold is released and the cart is closed. If you started a group payment, participants' payments are cancelled and refunded. This can't be undone.

announce.released: The room hold was released. You can now edit the cart.

errors.CART_NOT_OPEN: This cart can no longer be changed. Refresh the page to see its latest state.
